subject: Proposal: 3yr commitment — price stability pledge & uplift cap (Stratus Health)
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Ethan Turner <ethan.turner@stratushealth.com>, Stratus Health Procurement <procurement@stratushealth.com>
Cc: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Proposal: 3yr commitment — price stability pledge & uplift cap (Stratus Health)

Ethan / Procurement team,

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Attached is the updated Master Agreement (v3) and a simple 3-year pricing model that reflects the commercial terms we discussed. High level: 

- Term: 36 months (annual billing)
- Year 1 effective unit price: $0.012/token (list-equivalent basis)
- Applied customer discount: 35% off list (this exceeds standard playbook cap; flagging for internal approval)
- Price stability pledge: price locked for the full 36-month term for the SKU set included in Appendix A
- Uplift cap: maximum annual increase capped at 6% year-over-year (absolute cap, not CPI-linked)
- Renewal protection: at first renewal Redwood will not increase unit price by more than 1.5x the prior year uplift, and we commit to a written renewal pricing notice 120 days prior to renewal

Attachments: Stratus_MA-Draft_v3.pdf, pricing_model_3yr.xlsx (cost build).

Two asks from our side: 
1) Please confirm the attached Appendix A SKUs match what you expect for the 3-year commitment.
2) Can you confirm procurement routing — are you able to execute our standard DocuSign flow or do you need a countersigned PDF?

Note: We applied a 35% discount to achieve a price that fits Stratus’s unit economics. That exceeds the standard sales ask cap (25%), so I will route internally for approval this morning. I wanted to share the proposal with you now so you have it for your internal review.

If you prefer, we can hold the formal submission until I confirm internal approval (ETA today).

Best,
Monica Patel
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0121

Subject: Escalation: Stratus Health — 35% discount + 3yr price-lock / uplift cap request (DEAL-STR-2027-0315)

Laura / Rishi —

Escalating for executive approval: Stratus Health has requested a 3-year committed contract with the following non-standard commercial asks: 

- 35% one-off customer discount off list for the committed SKUs (our max standard is 25%)
- Firm 36-month price lock for the included SKUs
- Annual uplift cap of 6% (they requested 5% but our proposed economics landed at 6%)
- Renewal protection language: written notice 120 days prior and cap mechanics for the first renewal (see attached marked MA)

Why we recommend approving: 
- Large strategic healthcare account, ARR ramp expected to $2.4M ARR by year 3 if adopted
- Competitive procurement process — notable risk if we push back on price stability
- 3-year committed committed capacity helps justify GPU provisioning and reduces churn risk if we add a modest early termination recovery schedule

Risks / mitigations: 
- Margin compression in year 1 — mitigated by required minimum spend schedule and optional usage-based true-up in year 2
- Renewal inflation exposure — mitigated by the uplift cap and renewal protection clause we propose

Requested decision: Approve the exception to allow 35% discount + 6% uplift cap and the specified renewal protection. If approved, legal should add a short clause in Section 4.2 (Renewals) specifying the renewal cap math and 120-day notice.

Attachments: exec_summary_stratus.txt, pricing_model_3yr.xlsx, Stratus_MA-Draft_v3.pdf

Markus Klein
Head of Commercial Ops | Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.com
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>

Subject: RE: Escalation: Stratus Health — 35% discount + 3yr price-lock / uplift cap request (DEAL-STR-2027-0315)

Thanks for the clear packet and recommendations. I reviewed the numbers with Finance and Product. Decision below.

Decision: APPROVED with guarded conditions.

Conditions:
1) Approve 35% discount for the first 36-month term only, contingent on a minimum committed ARR schedule (see pricing_model_3yr.xlsx: Minimum Annual Commitment rows) and a standard early-termination recovery schedule in Appendix B.
2) Approve 36-month price lock for SKUs listed in Appendix A, with annual uplift cap set at 6% (as requested).
3) Renewal protection: on the first renewal Redwood will not increase unit price by more than 1.5x the prior year uplift OR 7%, whichever is lower. Legal to add explicit math example in the MA.
4) Execution flow: Monica to send the final MA via DocuSign link; procurement can countersign if needed but we prefer DocuSign. Monica — please confirm that Stratus agrees to the minimum spend table in the attached spreadsheet and then route to Legal for the clause insertion.

Markus / Rishi — please note this is an exception to playbook. Capture the approval in Deal Desk (DEAL-STR-2027-0315) and tag it for audit.

Monica — copy Legal on the DocuSign envelope and confirm whether Stratus needs a countersigned PDF. Once countersigned, ops will provision reserved capacity in the appropriate region and we will enable the price-lock SKU tagging.

Approved by: Laura Bennett
VP, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com
